proof: At a k-coordinate restriction, GH is parity of all k-1 remaining bits; its influence is k-1 regardless of affine terms and reached branch. True reach weights sum to1 at each depth. Sum = n(n-1)/2. Root derivative at each i is nonconstant parity of n-1 bits, so I=n/2.
scope: Actual Boolean family; refutes summing fresh mismatch tickets by O(root influence); not a counterexample to FEI.
